title: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance: Your Questions, Answered
description:
Do you own a business, freelance, or work as an independent contractor in Los Angeles? Diana Mangioglu, Director of Finance and City Treasurer for the City of Los Angeles, answers some of the most common questions about the Office of Finance and shares what business owners need to know to comply with local business tax requirements.

Learn more at Finance.LACity.gov.

Contact Information

Contact Center: 844-663-4411

Hours of Operation:
• Monday through Thursday: 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
• Friday: 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.

For in-person counter service at LA City Hall and the Van Nuys Office, visit Finance.LACity.gov for the most current hours.

Email: Finance.CustomerService@LACity.org

Frequently Asked Questions Covered:
00:00 - Beginning of video

03:51 - What is the Office of Finance doing to make registration & renewal easier?
04:41 - What should you do if you don't own a business, but do freelance work?
05:27 - What happens if I don't register or pay my business tax?
05:47 - What should I do if I close my business?
06:02 - When is it time to file my renewal?
06:44 - What if I started my business in the middle of the year?
07:05 - How can I connect with the Office of Finance?
